name: Gakuenjuu ~Ryoujoku Shidou Youryou~
source:
Main character is a part-time lecturer. There is a female teacher there who allows to anything with her body. But he grows tired of it and starts to gather information about weak sides of girls in order to insult them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名兼职讲师。那里有一位女老师，她的身体允许任何事情。但他对此感到厌倦，并开始收集有关女孩弱点的信息以侮辱她们。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
